name: kinesalud
description: Sistema de gestión de clientes, personal y seguimiento de tratamientos — Kinesalud y Vida

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kinesalud/shared && npm run build -w @kinesalud/web && npm run build -w @kinesalud/functions
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-kinesalud "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-kinesalud-it "npm run test:emulator -w @kinesalud/functions"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @kinesalud/functions && node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:start --project demo-kinesalud
